en: nonfunctional requirements: for example, the app should be fast, reliable, secure, legally compliant, and easy to maintain
a system is said to be scalable if its maximum throughput can be significantly increased by adding computing resources.
The response time is what the client sees; it includes all delays incurred anywhere in the system.
Latency is a catchall term for time during which a request is not being actively processed—that is, during which it is latent.
We call a system fault-tolerant if it continues providing the required service to users in spite of certain faults occurring.
Chaos engineering is a discipline that aims to improve confidence in fault-tolerance mechanisms through experiments such as deliberately injecting faults
